capabilities: : Select notes via tags or properties
intentEvidence: Track and align your focus! Focus Tracker is an Obsidian plugin for tracking activity, progress, and engagement across your notes over time.
motivation: One may find this useful as a component of their productivity/task-management system to help decide what areas need more attention in the future based on lack of attention or quality of attention in the past, leading to different prioritization of tasks, or as lead indicators in an OKR framework. I also find this useful as a component of my ADHD self-management system to help align my hyperfocus with my intent, setting time-block targets, etc.
problem: Users often struggle to monitor consistent effort, identify attention gaps, or align their daily work with long-term goals.

relations.evidence: Based on Habit Tracker 21, with significant adaptations for focus tracking and planning.

summary: Focus Tracker is a plugin that tracks activity and engagement across notes using a visual timeline to help users monitor patterns and align future attention with goals.
